item.title: WATCH | Opposition turned down governments second chief justice nominee, justice minister says
item.description: Justice Minister Jonathan Attard says that Friday’s meeting was meant to ascertain the Opposition’s stance on government’s second nominee, Miriam Hayman

item.title: Futsal matches to get video support for accurate referee decisions
item.description: Video support will be rolled out for the first time during the Enemed Super Cup Finals on Saturday

item.title: Suspended sentence after admitting to threatening ex-partner
item.description: Early guilty plea and police cooperation led to suspended sentence for man accused of threatening ex-partner

item.title: Jonathan Attard suggests anti-deadlock mechanism for chief justice vacancy if no agreement is reached
item.description: Xtra on TVM | Justice Minister supports the idea of an anti-deadlock mechanism if two-thirds majority is not reached

item.title: Decomposing body recovered from sea off Fawwara cliffs
item.description: Police investigations are ongoing on the discovery of a body off Fawwara cliffs

item.title: Two Maltese citizens arrested in Sicily over bird smuggling operation
item.description: Italian authorities found 1,500 protected birds in a van rented by two Maltese nationals and two Sicilians

item.title: Accused in luxury car theft was keeping cars safe after their owner died, court told
item.description: According to the accused, he moved the luxury cars to keep them in a safe place until the children of the deceased owner arrive in Malta from abroad

item.title: Vision 2050 launched in flamboyant ceremony outside Valletta gates
item.description: Government points to six flagship initiatives including the introduction of a mass transport system, an overhaul of public transport, and education reform as part of its long-term strategy during the launch of Malta Vision 2050 on Friday evening

item.title: Malta urged to address construction and entertainment noise
item.description: A report commissioned by the European Parliament’s Committee on Petitions reveals a disconnect between Malta’s legal compliance with EU noise laws and the daily reality for citizens, with construction, fireworks and entertainment noise falling through regulatory gaps. James Debono reports

item.title: Rialto redevelopment ordered to implement park and ride for roof top events
item.description: The Environment and Planning Review Tribunal has confirmed the Planning Authority’s approval for the redevelopment of Bormla’s historic Rialto Theatre, but ordered an amendment to the permit
